title: 🔥周期底部强于上轮
body: 市场处于相对强势的周期底部。对比上轮同期（2022-08），MVRV 为 1.21，显著高于当时的 1.03。这显示虽然 AHR999 同处于 0.35 的抄底区，但筹码并未陷入全面亏损的绝境。这种“强底”特征意味着当前更大概率是时间换空间，而非深度暴跌。变盘在即吗？
body_en: The market is holding a relatively strong cycle bottom. Compared to the same period last cycle (Aug '22), MVRV sits at 1.21, significantly higher than the 1.03 back then. This shows that while AHR999 is also in the 0.35 buy zone, chips haven't fallen into a state of total loss. This "strong bottom" dynamic implies a higher probability of trading time for space, rather than a deep crash. Is a pivot imminent?
